facts.statement: Papier was founded in 2015 and makes premium paper products for planning, writing, connecting and celebrating.

provenance.quote: Founded in 2015, Papier invites magic into the everyday with premium paper treasures for every desk. Whether setting out your wildest dreams on a page or scribbling a to-do list to get you ready for the day – stationery is a space to think, to connect, to plan, to celebrate.

facts.statement: Papier sells physical wedding planners containing overviews, budgets, to-do lists, guest and seating trackers, stationery tracking, gift lists and supplier contact sheets.

provenance.quote:
Ours includes everything you need, in order, on paper:

- A yearly and monthly overviews to keep your planning on track.
- Budget planners for each element of your day.
- Detailed wedding to-dos – from deciding on a date to preparing wedding favours and practising vows.
- Blank pages to fill with your own tasks.
- Pages to plan wedding party responsibilities.
- Guest list tracker and seating plan pages.
- Wedding stationery tracker – to make sure you've got everything from invitations to table menus covered.
- Gift lists – for you and your guests.
- Supplier contact sheets.

facts.statement: Papier sells removable-page keepsake binder journals with textured fabric covers, tabbed dividers, a lay-flat format and a keepsake envelope.

provenance.quote: Ours have beautifully textured fabric covers, removable pages, tabbed dividers and lay-flat format, plus a keepsake envelope for the pieces that don't quite belong on a page.
